name: Mutation too high
lesson: When about half of all letters are rewritten every generation, selection cannot hold on to what it has found.
lookFor: With pm = 0.5 per gene and this seed, the best string of a generation is below the best seen so far in 93 of the 100 generations. The best so far reaches 3 of 5 in generation 8 and is never improved, so HELLO is not found in 100 generations, and diversity stays above 0.83.
